## LACD v1.0.0 — first public release

Independent, generic, business-agnostic governance framework for agentic software development.

**Added**
- CLI (`lacd`): `init` / `doctor` / `status` (+`--json`) / `verify` (`--strict`, `--evidence`) / `upgrade` (`--check`, `--dry-run`, `--to`, `--prepare-pr`, `--accept-major`, `--template-dir`, `--yes`)
- Adoption state machine (7 states, 4 dimensions, reason codes), schema-validated status JSON
- Version lock (`.lacd/lock.json`), trusted-source discovery, SemVer compatibility policy
- Upgrade engine: 3-way migration, marked-section merge, conflict refusal, backup + rollback, idempotent re-runs
- `upgrade --prepare-pr`: branch + PR, dedupe, evidence-bound, never auto-merges
- T0/T1/T2 risk classification; agent protocol; remote-enforcement check (fail-closed)
- Tests: 301 passed (AT-01..AT-25, e2e, security negatives), coverage 88%

**Install**: `pip install "git+https://github.com/SkyCjq/LACD.git@v1.0.0"` (Python 3.11+, deps: pyyaml, jsonschema)

## Template bundle

`lacd-templates-1.0.0.zip` — SHA-256 verified by `lacd upgrade` before use:
